en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a street scene with a single‑story neoclassical building labeled as a hotel. The building has a portico with columns, a fenced yard with small trees, and hills in the background. In the foreground, several men in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk while a horse‑drawn carriage moves down the unpaved street. The caption at the top reads "Piatra‑Neamț, Hotel Continental," indicating the subject and location.
